contract: construct() -> three lists of cliques (vertex lists), one per instance from split_graph(n, k, p, seed) for (30,10,0.7,301), (60,20,0.7,302), (90,30,0.7,303) in the verifier: a clique on the first k vertices, an independent set on the rest and each cross pair joined with probability p (split graphs are chordal). Every listed set must be a clique with at least two vertices and every edge must lie in exactly one listed clique. Minimize the total number of cliques; the Erdős-Ordman-Zalcstein question asks whether n^2/6 + O(n) always suffice, and split graphs need at most 3n^2/16 + O(n).
notes: The score totals clique partition sizes on three fixed random split graphs; it measures a partitioning method. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs; reciprocal sums are reported as floats. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
